recipeIngredient: 6 cups diced apples (I use 4-5 large Honeycrisp, unpeeled)

recipeInstructions.text: Toss diced apples with the sugar, cinnamon, and flour in a large bowl until well-coated. Transfer to a 9×9 baking dish or a cast-iron skillet.
recipeInstructions.name: Mix Apple Filling

recipeInstructions.text: Mix melted butter, brown sugar, flour, oats, vanilla, and salt in a large bowl. Stir together with a spoon or fork. If needed, use your hands to bring the mixture together into a crumble; distribute evenly over the apples in the pan.
recipeInstructions.name: Mix Topping

recipeInstructions.text: Bake for 40-45 minutes, until the apples are jammy-looking around the edges, and the topping is golden brown.
recipeInstructions.name: Bake

recipeInstructions.text: Let stand for 10-15 minutes, so the apple layer can cool and thicken slightly. Serve with vanilla ice cream.
recipeInstructions.name: Rest and Serve

review.reviewBody: Ok so I’ve been making apple crisp for years. It’s so easy, how can it go wrong.  Well I read your post about the apples being “jammy” in this and I could never describe mine like that, so, with an abundance of apples from the orchard and company on the way, I thought why not trying something new?  Well, let me tell you, this IS better than my standard recipe!  The apples ARE jammy, and it comes together in a delicious way.  Company asked for seconds and hubby had it for breakfast.  My NEW apple crisp recipe from now on!

This. Is. AMAZING! Incredibly easy to prepare and it was a crowd favorite at a recent get together. Pairs perfectly with ice cream. This will be my go-to apple crisp recipe from now on! Thank you for sharing!!
This is your cousin :) Made this today with half the sugar and it was so simple and good. Now I have a great smelling house and will come back to this recipe next time.

I have made this twice in the past two weeks and shared the recipe with so many people. It is the perfect fall comfort dessert with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. I love that it is so easy and so delicious and uses ingredients I pretty much always have on hand!

Hubby said this is the best apple crisp he has ever had & I have to agree!
And trust me that is saying a lot, since this girl would trade almost anything for it at her school lunch.  It is so tasty with plenty of topping. :)
This is the best dessert I have ever made. I made it twice in less than 5 days for different events with friends and everyone loved it! Super easy too!
This apple crisp topping is so delicious. This recipe was amazing. We gobbled it up.
Thank you for making the one and only apple crisp recipe I need. My Decide once recipe!!!
This recipe is absolute perfection! Baked in a cast iron pan, and topped with vanilla ice cream- you can’t beat this one! *Chef’s kiss

I've made this apple crisp twice and my family and I love it. It's delicious, the topping is crisp and the ratio of apples to crisp is perfect. Thank you for sharing this absolutely wonderful recipe. I'm sure it will see regular rotation in our house.
Very good! I would maybe add a bit more cinnamon but that’s because I love cinnamon and maybe a little less sugar or brown sugar but it was great. Maybe a smidge sweet for me but super easy!
Absolutely delicious! So easy with not having to peel the apples. I used Cosmic Crisp because they’re my favorite and this did not disappoint. Made the house smell amazing and tasted even better!!!!

So excited to try this.  I get confused about the type of oats.  Old fashioned, steel cut, instant…..ack!!!  When you say rolled oats - do you have a specific type or brand you recommend, or do you think anything would work?
This is the perfect apple crisp recipe! Very easy to make, and the topping is delicious!

This was SO GOOD!
Can’t wait to add cranberries next time!
Had no ice cream but drizzled cream cheese icing over it!!
Thank you!
